brief: A caddy for my bench that holds three screwdrivers standing handle-up in deep bins so I can grab them without digging.

requirements.evidence: 3x 2-storey full bases with 3x hex-bin-full-x2 deep bins (bin:0,0,1, bin:0,1,1, bin:1,0,1); check_build meshClash clear

requirements.requirement: Holds three screwdrivers standing handle-up, grabbable without digging

finish.summary: Built 3-cell 2-storey caddy with three 2-stories-deep bins. Screwdriver stand pose was refused by physics check in both 1-deep and 2-deep bins, so drivers rest lying in bins rather than standing handle-up.
